name: Baños de Agua Santa
summary: Waterfalls, switchbacks and a two-night technical-riding/support base.
safetyNotes: Wet rock, traffic, tunnels and tourist congestion require conservative riding.
Keep technical riding on verified legal tracks.
filmingNotes: Use long-lens and stationary cameras; never stage public-road speed.
verificationNote: Confirm trail legality, closures and filming locations with local operators.

seasonalWeather.september: Variable mountain rain; mornings often provide the best window.
seasonalWeather.october: More mud and afternoon shower risk.

sections.title: Technical loop rule
sections.body: Every hard section needs a support-accessible bypass and a prebriefed regroup point.

name: Rotary Coordination — Baños
summary: Potential community-service coordination stop in central Ecuador.
safetyNotes: Confirm an actual host and project before displaying this as active.
filmingNotes: Community value comes before expedition promotion.
verificationNote: District 4400 identifies social reach in Baños; exact club/project details require confirmation.

sections.title: Consent
sections.body: The app requires host confirmation and participant release status before enabling a filming checklist.

name: Quilotoa Crater
summary: Signature crater reveal and high-elevation weather checkpoint.
safetyNotes: Wind, cold and altitude can degrade rider judgment.
Stay on authorized roads and visitor areas.
filmingNotes: Hold a quiet spatial reveal; do not crowd the rim or obstruct visitors.
verificationNote: Confirm local access, parking, community rules and weather on the day.

seasonalWeather.september: Clearer morning potential with strong wind and UV.
seasonalWeather.october: More cloud, rain and reduced visibility.

sections.title: Reveal shot
sections.body: Stage the camera only after the area is secure; preserve a quiet moment before narration.

name: Chugchilán
summary: Remote highland lodging and regroup base near Quilotoa.
safetyNotes: Fuel, medical and recovery services may be limited; arrive before dark.
filmingNotes: Confirm property and community filming consent.
verificationNote: Hotel selection, rates and availability are not bundled as current quotes.

seasonalWeather.september: Cold nights and relatively clearer mornings.
seasonalWeather.october: Wet afternoons and colder perceived conditions.

sections.title: Lodging contract
sections.body: Record cancellation terms, secure motorcycle parking, meal times, power availability and emergency transport.

name: Angamarca Backcountry Gate
summary: Planning gate for remote highland tracks and the hardest optional riding.
safetyNotes: No bundled trail is authorized here.
Use a local lead, sweep, satellite communications and a verified bailout.
filmingNotes: Camera placement must not block narrow roads or livestock movement.
verificationNote: Operational geometry must come from a current locally verified GPX file.

seasonalWeather.september: Potentially firmer surfaces, but cold and wind remain.
seasonalWeather.october: Mud and slope risk can make the route unsuitable.

sections.title: Operational lock
sections.body: This area remains disabled in turn-by-turn mode until a verified GPX and current access record are imported.

name: Cotopaxi Perimeter
summary: Volcano-perimeter scenic stage using only currently authorized access.
safetyNotes: Protected-area and motorcycle rules can change.
Never infer access from an old GPX or social post.
filmingNotes: Use established viewpoints and keep wildlife/visitor disturbance low.
verificationNote: Park and motorcycle access must be confirmed immediately before travel.

seasonalWeather.september: Often the preferred visibility window, with cold wind.
seasonalWeather.october: Cloud and precipitation are more likely.

sections.title: Protected-area rule
sections.body: The app requires a current access source and timestamp before displaying any internal route as operational.

name: Machachi / South Quito Support Base
summary: Final Andean regroup, lodging and mechanical-support area before Pifo/Quito.
safetyNotes: Avoid fatigue-driven late transfers into metropolitan traffic.
filmingNotes: Good location for the route debrief and equipment wrap sequence.
verificationNote: Confirm current lodging, mechanic and recovery providers.

seasonalWeather.september: Cold mornings and stronger afternoon wind.

sections.title: Debrief
sections.body: Close incident notes, media manifests, route deviations and maintenance issues before the final transfer.

name: Ingapirca Cultural Extension
summary: Optional southern cultural extension, not part of the compact eight-day loop.
safetyNotes: Requires substantial additional transit and a separate operating plan.
filmingNotes: Follow archaeological-site rules; avoid touching or climbing structures.
verificationNote: Confirm opening, conservation and filming rules and build a separate route plan.

seasonalWeather.september: Cool highland conditions with variable sun.

sections.title: Interpretation
sections.body: Use qualified local interpretation and clearly separate Cañari and Inca historical context.
